subject: Data Structures and Algorithms
syllabus_context: Unit III: Graph Algorithms and Traversal Paradigms. Representation of graphs, breadth-first exploration versus depth-first exploration, FIFO frontier management, visited tracking, shortest paths on unweighted graphs, algorithmic completeness.
declared_learning_objective: Explain the conceptual mechanics of Breadth-First Search, prove why a First-In-First-Out (FIFO) queue guarantees level-order discovery and unweighted shortest-path traversal, and explain the invariant function of the visited set.

provenance.source: KMIT Department of Computer Science & Engineering Lecture Series
provenance.institution: Keshav Memorial Institute of Technology, Hyderabad

recording_quality.known_observability_limitations: Diagrammatic node connections described verbally with whiteboard pointer.
